scope: Focused first-party performance qualification of exact integrated source, not full compiler post-merge CI
lock_scope: One build action, then a separate test action; no nested/campaign lock. Waiting for unrelated owners is included in raw logs.

build.command:
set -eu
cd /home/david/buster-fast-bench/performance-pages-384-390/first-party/main-4f4a0bf/source
date -u
uname -r
clang --version
bash tools/performance/build.sh
reader_harness=/home/david/buster-fast-bench/performance-pages-384-390/first-party/main-4f4a0bf/evidence/docs/measurements/performance-first-party-2026-10-25
pages_harness=/home/david/buster-fast-bench/performance-pages-384-390/first-party/main-4f4a0bf/evidence/docs/measurements/performance-pages-2026-10-25
clang -std=c17 -D_GNU_SOURCE -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I tools/performance "$reader_harness/validate.c" -o build/performance/test-first-party
clang -std=c17 -D_GNU_SOURCE -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I tools/performance "$reader_harness/import-tests.c" -o build/performance/test-import-first-party
clang -std=c17 -D_GNU_SOURCE -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I tools/performance "$pages_harness/profile-validation.c" -o build/performance/test-profile
readelf -d build/performance/capture build/performance/profile build/performance/publish
date -u

test.command:
set -eu
cd /home/david/buster-fast-bench/performance-pages-384-390/first-party/main-4f4a0bf/source
date -u
uname -n
awk '/model name/ {print; exit}' /proc/cpuinfo
reader_root=/home/david/buster-fast-bench/performance-pages-384-390/first-party/main-4f4a0bf/evidence
reader_fixture="$reader_root/docs/measurements/performance-format-2026-10-24"
reader_harness="$reader_root/docs/measurements/performance-first-party-2026-10-25"
pages_harness="$reader_root/docs/measurements/performance-pages-2026-10-25"
build/performance/bmf --self-test
build/performance/test-first-party "$reader_fixture" "$reader_root" docs/performance/buster-manifest-v1.schema.json
build/performance/test-import-first-party
build/performance/bmf validate "$reader_harness/history/census/manifest.bmf.json"
build/performance/bmf validate "$reader_harness/history/foreign-strings/manifest.bmf.json" --evidence-root "$reader_root"
build/performance/test-profile "$reader_fixture/profile-example/capture.pftrace" "$pages_harness/profile/capture.pftrace"
build/performance/bmf validate "$pages_harness/profile/manifest.bmf.json"
for manifest in "$pages_harness/history-partitioned/"*.bmf.json
do
    build/performance/bmf validate "$manifest"
done
build/performance/capture --no-sampling build/performance/main-qualification-launch 2 1000000 -- /usr/bin/true
date -u

results.mutation_note: Some byte mutations change valid values or ignorable padding; these are memory-safety probes, not blanket rejection claims.

results.scope: CSV/Git/metadata source preservation; full frozen census is a separate integration check

results.note: A complete native packet prefix can be a valid smaller trace. Resource size/hash and capture receipt establish the intended complete artifact.

test.log_encoding: gzip -n archival compression preserves exact original stdout/stderr, including significant trailing whitespace; not a project runtime dependency

operator_attempt.reason: The optional hostname utility was unavailable, so the strict shell stopped before running tests. Replaced metadata command with existing uname -n; no implementation/source change or test bypass.

full_post_merge_ci.note: Separate whole-compiler CI remains pending; not replaced or reported as passed by these focused checks.

symbol_oracle.scope: Local static independent symbol oracle against the immutable target binary; no runtime/project dependency or performance claim.
symbol_oracle.raw_output_encoding: gzip -n archival compression; raw_output_sha256 identifies uncompressed original bytes
